Testimonials.title: Real stories.
Testimonials.subtitle: See how Findmus helps people get their belongings back.

laptop.quote: “Honestly, the relief was the best part. My laptop had been handed in at the library, and someone scanned the sticker to reach me. It took until the next morning to collect it, but at least I knew where it was.”
laptop.name: Michael T.

suitcase.quote: “Two very similar suitcases got mixed up after our flight. The sticker gave the other traveller a way to contact me, and we sorted out a swap. More luggage-friendly tag options would be nice, though.”
suitcase.name: Sarah K.

jacket.quote: “Another school jacket gone, or so I thought. A parent found it at the playground and called using the details on the Findmus page. It was back by Monday. Saved us buying another one.”
jacket.name: Ama S.

keys.quote: “Wasn’t sure anyone would bother scanning it. Turns out someone did when my keys were found on a walking trail. We arranged a nearby pickup. A proper keyring version would be handy.”
keys.name: Daniel R.

backpack.quote: “Getting my course notes back mattered more than the bag itself. It had been found on the bus, and the person used Findmus to get in touch. We had to work out a pickup time, but it was pretty straightforward.”
backpack.name: Priya M.

wallet.quote: “The café had my wallet behind the counter before I even realised it was missing. Someone scanned the sticker and let me know. A smaller sticker for narrow card slots would be useful, but this one did the job.”
wallet.name: James L.

FAQ.title: Everything you need to know
FAQ.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about Findmus.

howItWorks.question: How does Findmus work?
howItWorks.answer: You stick a Findmus QR code on your item. If someone finds it, they scan the code and can securely contact you through our platform.

privacy.question: Is my information private?
privacy.answer: Yes. Your personal details are never shown. Finders can only message you through a secure, anonymous channel.

notifications.question: How will I be notified?
notifications.answer: You’ll receive an instant notification via email or SMS when someone scans your Findmus QR code.

items.question: What can I use Findmus on?
items.answer: Findmus works on laptops, phones, bags, bikes, keys, clothing, pet items, and almost anything you value.

subscription.question: Do I need a subscription?
subscription.answer: No. There’s no subscription required. You only need to activate your Findmus code after purchase.

help.question: What if I need help?
help.answer: We’re here for you. Contact our support team anytime and we’ll be happy to assist.
